people.name: Eden
people.line: The perfect garden where God placed Adam and Eve.

translations.web: Yahweh God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the man whom he had formed.
translations.bsb: And the LORD God planted a garden in Eden, in the east, where He placed the man He had formed.
translations.kjv: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.
translations.asv: And Jehovah God planted a garden eastward, in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.
